name: Vegas Cubing Cup Fall 2024

venue.name: The Orleans Hotel & Casino
venue.address: 4500 W Tropicana Ave, Las Vegas, NV 89103

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VegasCubingCupFall2024#37260-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](http://speedcubeshop.com) and [West Coast Cubing](http://westcoastcubing.com), in partnership with [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive):

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU1OTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f47ea96fb325b450f0892e8e2cfaf1c35be48948/scswcc5.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1NKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--928aebc1c75f745abb0b80097896dba5180958fd/image.png)

This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels.
